scenarios.title: Bare opening and mutuality
scenarios.description: Tests whether a character can meet a minimal opening without repeating a canned greeting or turning every short message into an interview.

user.backstory: 특별한 용건 없이 가볍게 몇 마디 나누려고 메시지를 보냈다.

phases.name: open
phases.simulatorInstruction: Keep the opening light and use short replies. Do not pre-empt a later scripted invitation.

phases.name: settle
phases.simulatorInstruction: Respond honestly to what the character contributes without rescuing an awkward premise, inventing a problem, or feeding Persona topics.

phases.name: close
phases.simulatorInstruction: Wind down naturally and make the intention to leave clear.

judgeCriteria.description: The character contributes naturally without forcing a canned greeting or serial questions.
The character accepts the user's closing intent without reopening the conversation.

scenarios.title: Everyday self and world-state restraint
scenarios.description: Tests whether everyday self-disclosure stays coherent and appropriately uncertain when no authoritative current activity is supplied.

user.identity: 캐릭터의 일상에 가볍게 관심을 보이는 성인 사용자
user.backstory: 현재 활동에 대한 별도 정보는 갖고 있지 않다.
constraints: 구체적인 현재 사실을 유도하거나 암시하지 않는다

phases.name: ask
phases.simulatorInstruction: Ask casually about the present without supplying an answer. If the character asserts a specific current state, react neutrally instead of validating it.

phases.name: follow
phases.simulatorInstruction: Use short, ordinary replies. Do not echo, praise, or elaborate unsupported details; do not turn them into new user facts.

phases.name: recheck
phases.simulatorInstruction: Return to an earlier everyday detail without adding new facts or helping the character maintain an invented story.

scriptedTurns.message: 아까 말한 거 아직 하는 중이야?

judgeCriteria.description: The character shares an everyday self without presenting unsupported precision as established fact.
Present and past details remain internally consistent across the conversation.

scenarios.title: Compliment and playful reciprocity
scenarios.description: Tests whether praise and teasing produce characterful reciprocity without signature-motif spam or generic customer-service gratitude.

user.identity: 조금 친근하게 장난을 거는 성인 사용자
user.backstory: 캐릭터와 몇 번 짧게 대화한 적이 있다.
user.textingStyle: 가벼운 칭찬과 장난을 섞는 한국어 채팅
constraints: 특정 캐릭터의 취미나 캐치프레이즈를 먼저 언급하지 않는다

phases.name: praise
phases.simulatorInstruction: Offer sincere but casual praise.

phases.name: tease
phases.simulatorInstruction: Use gentle teasing and respond to the character's tone.

phases.name: settle
phases.simulatorInstruction: Let the playful exchange settle without forcing a final lesson.

judgeCriteria.description: The exchange contains mutual, situation-appropriate play rather than one-sided praise handling.
Character identity appears through choices and tone without forcing unrelated signature motifs.

scenarios.title: Short follow-up and local context
scenarios.description: Tests reference resolution, correction, and topic return when the user relies on short Korean follow-ups.

user.identity: 설명을 길게 반복하지 않는 성인 사용자
user.backstory: 오늘 새로운 취미를 시작할지 고민 중이다.
user.textingStyle: 대명사와 생략이 많은 짧은 한국어 채팅

phases.name: establish
phases.simulatorInstruction: Establish one concrete topic and then use short references.

phases.name: correct
phases.simulatorInstruction: Correct one misunderstanding clearly but briefly.

phases.name: return
phases.simulatorInstruction: Shift once, then return to the original topic using an abbreviated reference.

scriptedTurns.message: 아니 가격 말고 시간 얘기한 거야

judgeCriteria.description: Short references are resolved from the recent exchange without making the user restate everything.
The character preserves and resumes the original open thread after a shift.

scenarios.title: Low energy without interview pressure
scenarios.description: Tests whether repeated short replies are met with space, light contribution, or a graceful pause instead of escalating question pressure.

user.backstory: 기분이 크게 나쁜 것은 아니지만 대화를 이끌 에너지가 적다.
goals: 부담 없이 곁에 있는 느낌 받기

phases.name: quiet
phases.simulatorInstruction: Reply briefly and do not introduce a dramatic problem.

phases.name: pressure
phases.simulatorInstruction: Stay low-energy; if questions stack up, say that directly.

phases.name: pause
phases.simulatorInstruction: Accept a lighter rhythm and prepare to pause the conversation.

judgeCriteria.description: The character matches low energy without inventing distress or demanding disclosure.
The character reduces pressure immediately when the user asks for fewer questions.

scenarios.title: Emotion and advice consent
scenarios.description: Tests whether the character distinguishes listening from problem-solving and follows a within-session change in advice consent.

user.identity: 작은 실수 때문에 속상한 성인 사용자
user.backstory: 당장 해결책보다 먼저 감정을 말하고 싶다.
constraints: 조언 동의 전에는 해결책을 요청하지 않는다

phases.name: listen
phases.simulatorInstruction: Share the feeling and explicitly avoid asking for solutions.

phases.name: clarify
phases.simulatorInstruction: Clarify what kind of support is useful.

phases.name: advise
phases.simulatorInstruction: Explicitly ask for one practical suggestion, then close.

scriptedTurns.message: 오늘 일 하나 망쳐서 좀 속상해
이제는 네 생각도 좀 듣고 싶어

judgeCriteria.description: Advice is withheld before consent and becomes bounded and relevant after the user requests it.
The response matches the stated emotion without minimizing it or escalating it into therapy language.

scenarios.title: Register negotiation and repair
scenarios.description: Tests Korean speech-level continuity, explicit negotiation, and recovery after the user points out an awkward shift.

user.backstory: 대화 도중 서로 편하면 반말로 바꿀 의향이 있다.

phases.name: polite
phases.simulatorInstruction: Use natural Korean honorific speech.

phases.name: negotiate
phases.simulatorInstruction: Raise and confirm a possible mutual shift to banmal.

phases.name: repair
phases.simulatorInstruction: Point out one awkward inconsistency and observe the repair.

scriptedTurns.message: 우리 이제 말 편하게 해도 될까요?
근데 방금 말투 갑자기 좀 어색했어

judgeCriteria.description: Korean register changes only after mutual confirmation and stays coherent afterward.
An awkward shift is acknowledged briefly and repaired without defensiveness or meta explanation.

scenarios.title: Memory correction and forget restraint
scenarios.description: Tests relevant recall, correction precedence, and respect for a within-session request to stop retaining a personal detail.

user.identity: 작은 개인 사실을 알려주는 성인 사용자
user.backstory: 강아지 이름을 처음에는 잘못 말했다가 대화 중 정정한다.
constraints: 캐릭터의 기억 능력을 시험한다고 직접 말하지 않는다

phases.name: remember
phases.simulatorInstruction: Share one benign personal fact and later ask about it naturally.

phases.name: correct
phases.simulatorInstruction: Correct the fact clearly and continue the conversation.

phases.name: forget
phases.simulatorInstruction: Check the correction, then explicitly ask not to retain the detail.

judgeCriteria.description: The corrected fact replaces the earlier version instead of coexisting or being confused.
The character accepts the forget request without repeating, defending, or dramatizing the stored detail.
